meta.title: 看来我没办法解决这个问题
meta.titleEn: It seems I can't solve this problem
meta.topic: 会议安排、设备问题、团队分工与重要选择
meta.courseModel: 三次课：确认会议与设备 → 根据现象推测并求助 → 完成团队任务并表达个人选择
meta.sourceTextPolicy: 四篇教材中文和拼音逐行保留；“笔记本（电脑）”按 laptop 教学；课文四使用日记布局；英文译文、生活讨论、练习和任务属于教学扩展。

pedagogy.speakingParticipation: 职场情境可迁移到班级、小组、社团和课程展示；每位组员都要表达，不要求已有工作经历。
pedagogy.cultureFactPolicy: 个人学习、工作、城市和家庭选择允许不同答案，不设置唯一正确立场。

sessions.title: 第一次课：确认会议与设备选择
第二次课：描述设备问题并决定求助
第三次课：完成任务并表达重要选择

1.title: 确认会议与设备选择
1.subtitle: 先确认变更，再比较电脑并完成会前准备。

steps.title: 经理不在，会议改期
steps.talkHint: 找经理办公室、日历和正在确认时间的两位同事。
steps.prompt: 会议信息发生了哪些变化？

steps.talkHint: 比较会议室电脑、笔记本电脑和连接线。

2.title: 观察设备问题并决定求助
2.subtitle: 先说看见和听见的现象，再用“看来”得出结论。

3.subtitle: 有人请假时重新分工，确认时间后把任务做完。

4.subtitle: 听见新的工作机会，再从个人角度说明重要选择。

grammar.title: “还是”和“或者”
grammar.scene: Compare a choice question with a statement that offers acceptable alternatives.
grammar.structure: 选择疑问句：A 还是 B？　陈述句：A 或者 B 都可以。
grammar.explanation: “还是”常用于请对方选择；“或者”常用于陈述可选办法。本课只学习这两个常用功能。

grammar.title: 固定短语“看来”
grammar.scene: Observe visible evidence first, then draw a reasonable conclusion.
grammar.structure: 可观察的事实，看来 + 结论。
grammar.explanation: “看来”表示说话人根据已经看到、听到或想到的情况作出推测，不只是表达个人喜好。

grammar.title: “把”字句（3）：动作产生结果
grammar.titleEn: 把 sentences (3): result of an action
grammar.scene: Continue from L10: focus on the result achieved after handling a specific object.
grammar.structure: 主语 + 把 + 确定宾语 + 动词 + 结果补语
grammar.explanation: 动词后必须说明动作产生的结果；本课的“接”表示连接设备，“接好”表示连接并准备好。

grammar.title: 固定格式“对……来说”
grammar.scene: Compare what matters to different people without choosing one correct value.
grammar.structure: 对 + 人 / 对象 + 来说，观点、感受或重要性。
grammar.explanation: “对……来说”先说明观点属于谁；不同的人可以有不同而且合理的答案。

lines.english: The manager isn't here this afternoon, so there won't be a meeting.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 那什么时候开会？
lines.pinyin: Nà shénme shíhou kāihuì?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 后天上午十点，会议地点换到第一会议室。我正要给大家发邮件。
lines.pinyin: Hòutiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn, huìyì dìdiǎn huàn dào dì-yī huìyìshì. Wǒ zhèng yào gěi dàjiā fā yóujiàn.
lines.english: At 10:00 the morning after tomorrow. The location has been moved to Conference Room 1. I'm just about to send an email to everyone.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 开会的时候，我们用会议室的电脑还是自己的笔记本电脑？
lines.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, wǒmen yòng huìyìshì de diànnǎo háishì zìjǐ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo?
lines.english: During the meeting, will we use the conference room computer or our own laptops?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 会议室的电脑或者自己的电脑都可以。
lines.pinyin: Huìyìshì de diànnǎo huòzhě zìjǐ de diànnǎo dōu kěyǐ.
lines.english: Either the conference room computer or your own laptop is fine.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 那到时候咱们早点儿过去，你帮我把电脑接好吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà dào shíhou zánmen zǎo diǎnr guòqu, nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ diànnǎo jiēhǎo ba.
lines.english: Then let's go there a bit earlier then, and you can help me connect the computer.

texts.title: 会议室设备问题
texts.setting: 在会议室，王一雪跟杨同乐在做会前准备。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 电脑接好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Diànnǎo jiēhǎo le ma?
lines.english: Is the computer connected?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 已经接好了，您开机看看有没有问题。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng jiēhǎo le, nín kāijī kànkan yǒu méiyǒu wèntí.
lines.english: It's already connected. Please turn it on to see if there are any issues.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 现在什么都看不见。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài shénme dōu kàn bu jiàn.
lines.english: I can't see anything right now.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 我检查一下哪里出问题了……您再试一下。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiǎnchá yíxià nǎli chū wèntí le... Nín zài shì yíxià.
lines.english: Let me check where the problem is... Please try again.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 看见了，但是听不见声音。
lines.pinyin: Kànjiàn le, dànshì tīng bu jiàn shēngyīn.
lines.english: I can see it, but I can't hear any sound.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 现在呢？
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài ne?
lines.english: How about now?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 听得见声音，但是声音有点儿小，听不清楚。
lines.pinyin: Tīng de jiàn shēngyīn, dànshì shēngyīn yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, tīng bu qīngchu.
lines.english: I can hear the sound, but it's a bit low and unclear.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 看来我没办法解决这个问题，只能找别人来帮帮忙了。
lines.pinyin: Kànlái wǒ méi bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí, zhǐ néng zhǎo biérén lái bāngbangmáng le.
lines.english: It seems I can't solve this problem; I'll have to ask someone else for help.

texts.title: 一起把工作做完
texts.setting: 在办公室里，王一雪跟杨同乐在聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 同乐，你看见老张了吗？
lines.pinyin: Tónglè, nǐ kànjiàn Lǎo Zhāng le ma?
lines.english: Tongle, have you seen Lao Zhang?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 老张没来。他说家里有点儿事，所以请假了。
lines.pinyin: Lǎo Zhāng méi lái. Tā shuō jiā li yǒudiǎnr shì, suǒyǐ qǐngjià le.
lines.english: Lao Zhang did not come. He said he had some family matters, so he asked for leave.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 好几个同事都休假了，开会前这么多工作我怕干不完。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ gè tóngshì dōu xiūjià le, kāihuì qián zhème duō gōngzuò wǒ pà gàn bu wán.
lines.english: Several colleagues are on vacation. With so much work before the meeting, I'm afraid I won't finish it.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 十二点多了，咱们先去吃饭吧。吃完饭，我跟您一起把这些工作做完。
lines.pinyin: Shí'èr diǎn duō le, zánmen xiān qù chī fàn ba. Chīwán fàn, wǒ gēn nín yìqǐ bǎ zhèxiē gōngzuò zuò wán.
lines.english: It's past 12:00. Let's go eat first. After eating, I'll finish up all this work together with you.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 你先去吃，我想再干一会儿。明天开会前要发到公司的邮箱里。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù chī, wǒ xiǎng zài gàn yíhuìr. Míngtiān kāihuì qián yào fā dào gōngsī de yóuxiāng li.
lines.english: You go ahead and eat first; I would like to work a bit longer. It needs to be sent to the company mailbox before tomorrow’s meeting.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 您没看到邮件吗？经理还没回来呢，下周才能开会。
lines.pinyin: Nín méi kàndào yóujiàn ma? Jīnglǐ hái méi huílái ne, xià zhōu cái néng kāihuì.
lines.english: Didn't you see the email? The manager hasn't returned yet; the meeting won't happen until next week.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 那不着急了。走，吃饭去。
lines.pinyin: Nà bù zháojí le. Zǒu, chī fàn qu.
lines.english: Then there's no rush. Let's go eat.

texts.title: 工作机会与重要选择
texts.author: 王一雪
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪在写日记。
texts.translationPolicy: 中文和拼音为教材原文；英文译文、日记标题和生活讨论为教学辅助。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 前几天，上海的同事来北京了。一起吃饭时，他们跟我说最近有不少同事去上海工作了，问我愿不愿意也去上海。我是这样想的：现在丈夫和孩子都在北京，刘明的工作很忙，小雪和小明也都还小，我去别的城市工作就要离开他们。虽然去上海可能会有更好的机会，但是对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为工作或学习离开家人。
lines.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān, Shànghǎi de tóngshì lái Běijīng le. Yìqǐ chī fàn shí, tāmen gēn wǒ shuō zuìjìn yǒu bù shǎo tóngshì qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò le, wèn wǒ yuàn bu yuànyì yě qù Shànghǎi. Wǒ shì zhèyàng xiǎng de: Xiànzài zhàngfu hé háizi dōu zài Běijīng, Liú Míng de gōngzuò hěn máng, Xiǎoxuě hé Xiǎomíng yě dōu hái xiǎo, wǒ qù biéde chéngshì gōngzuò jiù yào líkāi tāmen. Suīrán qù Shànghǎi kěnéng huì yǒu gèng hǎo de jīhuì, dànshì duì wǒ lái shuō, shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào, wǒ bú yuànyì wèi gōngzuò huò xuéxí líkāi jiārén.
lines.english: A few days ago, colleagues from Shanghai came to Beijing. While we were eating together, they told me that quite a few colleagues had recently gone to work in Shanghai and asked whether I would also be willing to go. This is how I think about it: my husband and children are in Beijing now. Liu Ming is very busy with work, and Xiaoxue and Xiaoming are still young. Working in another city would mean leaving them. Although Shanghai might offer better opportunities, life is also important to me, and I am not willing to leave my family for work or study.

instructions.required: 完成“我的团队任务与重要选择”的当次准备卡；A和B保存的材料必须用于C。
instructions.optional: 不需要上传录音；可带自制信息卡、问题示意图或不含隐私的活动图片。
instructions.aiPolicy: 先独立记录真实活动、问题和选择，再使用工具检查语言。

A.label: 团队任务 · 第1步
A.goal: 制作会议或小组活动信息卡，说明时间、地点、参加者、设备和选择。
A.suggested_mix: 保存信息卡和一张自制或隐私安全图片，供B、C继续使用。

B.label: 团队任务 · 第2步
B.goal: 制作问题与求助卡，写清现象、检查过程、看来结论和下一步办法。
B.suggested_mix: 在A的活动上增加一个真实或合理的问题情境。

C.label: 课堂最终项目 · 我的团队任务与重要选择
C.goal: 整合A/B，完成1—2分钟课堂分享。
C.suggested_mix: 不强制上传录音；可小组彩排，但每位学生都要说。

A.projectStage: 团队任务 1/3 · 选择活动
A.prompt_cn: 你要安排什么会议、小组项目、社团活动或课程展示？
A.prompt_en: What meeting, group project, club activity or class presentation will you organize?

A.projectStage: 团队任务 1/3 · 保存到最终展示
A.prompt_cn: 写清时间、地点、参加者、设备和准备事项；提出一个“还是”问题，并用“或者”写一个可选办法。
A.prompt_en: Create one meeting or activity information card. State the time, place, participants, equipment and preparation. Ask one choice question with 还是 and write one alternative statement with 或者.
A.answerPlaceholder: 活动：……。时间：……。地点：……。我们用……还是……？……或者……都可以。开会前要把……接好 / 准备好。

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按句框完成5句话，写时间、地点、设备和一个选择。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 独立写完整信息，并自然区分“还是”和“或者”。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 增加变更通知和备用设备办法，说明谁负责准备。

A.projectStage: 下一次课 · Meeting or Activity Card
A.prompt_cn: Classroom Preparation: Meeting or Activity Card
A.prompt_en: Bring your information card and one useful visual.
presentationPlan: Bring one self-made information card and one privacy-safe photo or simple diagram of the place or equipment.
Be ready to answer: What is the activity? When and where is it? Who will join? What equipment is needed?
Use at least four lesson words and ask one complete question with 还是; answer with an 或者 statement.
State who will connect or prepare the equipment. Partners may check information together; no audio upload is required.
A.classroomNote: Keep this card. You will add a problem-and-help card in Homework B.

B.projectStage: 团队任务 2/3 · 观察问题
B.prompt_cn: 活动准备中可能出现什么设备、学习或小组问题？你能观察到什么？
B.prompt_en: What equipment, study or group-task problem might occur? What can you directly observe?
B.answerPlaceholder: 我看见 / 听见……。我已经检查……。

B.projectStage: 团队任务 2/3 · 保存依据和下一步
B.prompt_cn: 在A的信息卡上增加一个问题：写出看得见/看不见、听得见/听不清楚等现象，说明检查过程，用“看来”得出结论，再决定继续处理还是找谁帮忙。
B.prompt_en: Add one problem to your Homework A activity. Record visible or audible evidence, what you checked, a conclusion with 看来, and whether you will continue or ask someone for help.
B.answerPlaceholder: 现在……看得见 / 看不见，……听得见 / 听不清楚。我检查了……。看来……。我只能 / 决定……。
picturePrompts: 一个设备问题的自制示意图
检查过的连接、屏幕或声音设置

carryFrom.label: A · 会议或活动信息卡

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按句框写4—5句话：现象、检查、看来结论和求助。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 至少使用两组可能补语，并清楚说明自己试过什么。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较继续自己处理和找别人帮助两种办法，解释选择。

B.projectStage: 下一次课 · Problem and Help Card
B.prompt_cn: Classroom Preparation: Problem and Help Card
B.prompt_en: Bring your evidence, conclusion and next-step card.
presentationPlan: Bring your Homework A card plus one self-made, privacy-safe problem diagram or selected image.
Be ready to answer: What can or cannot be seen or heard? What did you check? What does the evidence suggest?
Use 看来 only after observable evidence. Include one of 看得见/看不见, 听得见/听不见 or 听得清楚/听不清楚.
Decide whether to continue or ask a specific person for help. Partners may role-play the request; no audio upload is required.
B.classroomNote: Save the evidence, conclusion and next step. You will combine them with Homework A in the final presentation.

C.projectStage: 团队任务 3/3 · 组织展示
C.prompt_cn: 听众需要知道哪些信息，才能理解你的活动安排、问题、解决过程和重要选择？
C.prompt_en: What must your audience know to understand your plan, problem, solution process and important choice?
C.answerPlaceholder: 听众需要知道时间、地点、设备、问题、依据、分工、结果和我的选择。

C.projectStage: 课堂大作业 · 我的团队任务与重要选择
C.prompt_cn: 整合A的信息卡和B的问题求助卡，准备1—2分钟课堂分享。说明怎样把一项任务做完，再用“对……来说”表达自己重视的学习、工作或生活因素。
C.prompt_en: Combine your information card from A and problem-and-help card from B. Prepare a 1–2 minute class presentation. Explain how the team completes one task and use 对……来说 to state what matters in study, work or life.
C.answerPlaceholder: 我们的活动是……。时间和地点是……。我们用……还是……？……或者……都可以。后来……，看来……。我们先……，再把……做完。对我来说，……很重要，因为……。

carryFrom.label: A · 会议或活动信息卡

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按句框完成7—8句话；必须有一个结果类“把”字句和一个“对……来说”。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 独立组织1—2分钟分享，至少使用6个本课词和3个本课语法结构。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较两个办法或选择，说明证据、团队结果和个人理由，并回应一个同学问题。

C.projectStage: 最终回收 · My Team Task and Important Choice
C.prompt_cn: Classroom Presentation: My Team Task and Important Choice
C.prompt_en: Present your project mainly in class.
presentationPlan: Bring one to three self-made or privacy-safe images plus your information card from A and problem-and-help card from B.
Answer: What is the activity? When and where? What equipment? What went wrong? What evidence did you observe? Who did what? What was completed? What matters to you?
Use at least six lesson words and at least three lesson structures. You must include one result 把 sentence and one 对……来说 sentence.
Speak for 1–2 minutes. Rehearse in pairs or small groups, but every student must speak. Listen respectfully to different choices. Audio upload is not required.
C.classroomNote: Use the saved work from A and B. Mistakes and weak points stay collapsed until you choose to review them.

focus: 我的团队任务与重要选择

recommendationRules.then: 重做对应A/B/C五阶段预习并复习错词。
用A的信息卡和B的问题求助卡重新完成一次1分钟团队任务分享。
